posts.text:
Don't let your inability to do everything undermine your determination to do something.

Video

Now is not the time to agonize. It is time to organize.

Not time to retreat, but to rise. 

To activate. To engage. To mobilize.

Democracy is not a spectator sport. 

This moment demands our presence, our courage, and our action.

We have work to do. Let’s show up and meet the demands of this moment.

Video

Donald Trump is clear: American families’ financial struggles don’t matter to him at all.

If congressional Republicans don’t want to hold him accountable and help end his reckless wars and bring down prices, they should get the hell out of the way.

Video

This makes me ticked off. The Trump administration gutted USAID over a year ago, but the devastating human cost has continued. We cannot look away. We must restore our leadership and fight for aid programs to feed children, improve global health, and protect our national interests.

Video

Trump’s settlement is so effing ridiculous. 

Republicans in Congress are enabling historic levels of corruption, graft, and greed as Trump steals hundreds of millions of dollars from our nation.

Video

We can feel the despair and sorrow about this roll back of our rights that people bled and fought for, but we must also hold in our heart a defiant joy.

Video

This is the most corrupt President in the history of our country.

But let me be clear: every branch of our government now has corruption that is cancerous and eating away at our democracy. 

We must demand change.

Video

We don’t have to ask ourselves what we would have done at dark moments in our history.

We are in one of these moments where history is calling on us.

Now it's on us, what will we do?

I believe we must stand up.

Video

I’ve been running hard these past weeks, from D.C. to New Jersey to states across the country. Long days. Too little sleep. Fired up by what’s happening in our nation.

And yet, in the middle of all of it, I keep meeting people carrying burdens heavier than mine who still choose kindness.

Recently, I went into a hot kitchen after an event to thank the staff preparing the food. One man was sweaty, clearly grinding through a long day. I thanked him and started to walk away when he stopped me and

We must defend our sacred right to vote against a Supreme Court determined to strip them away. From Dred Scott to Plessy to Korematsu, history teaches us that the answer is never passive acceptance — but to stand up, organize, and mobilize.

The power of the people will always be greater than the people in power. When we fight together, we win.

Video

This isn’t a partisan moment, it’s a movement moment.

I’m in Alabama today to stand up for Voting Rights. This fight is urgent and we all need to make our voices heard.

Video

This is a civic altar call for all those who understand that faith without works is dead. That true hope will never let despair have the last word.

Video

We are standing on sacred soil, drinking from wells of liberty and freedom we did not dig.

We must stand now so that future generations enjoy the blessings so many fought and bled for.

Video

Love thy neighbor. Congratulations class of 2026!

Video

Parents shouldn’t have to pay thousands of dollars just so their kids can play sports. 

Youth sports change lives. It shouldn’t be a luxury only for the wealthy.

That’s why I’m fighting for the Let Kids Play Act — to push back against private equity greed and bring costs down for every family.

Video

Trump doesn’t care about cutting costs for American families — not skyrocketing groceries, not crushing gas prices. His biggest concern is building himself a ballroom.

Video

More and more people in the MAHA movement are feeling betrayed—and they're calling out the Trump administration’s broken promises on cleaner air, safer food that’s free of toxic chemicals, and healthier lives for our kids and families.

Video

I want to share with you some deeply powerful advice from a woman whose life and words have inspired millions — Oprah Winfrey.

Video

Martyrs for our democracy overcame our past.

We can overcome the terrible Supreme Court decision now if we take this election seriously.

Video

Trump is putting brave Americans in harms way with his dangerous and failed war with Iran, while at home comfortable Congress people are not doing their job to defend the constitution.

It is unacceptable.

Video
